name: sparkhub-sdk-monorepo
description: Workspaces root for @sparkhub/sdk + @sparkhub/react. The published packages live under packages/.

scripts.verify: npm run build:ordered && npm run type-check && npm run test
scripts.build:ordered: npm -w @sparkhub/sdk run build && npm -w @sparkhub/react run build && npm -w @sparkhub/kb-viewer run build && npm -w @sparkhub/kb-editor run build
